commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+2' Bayer Leverkusen slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' The attendance is 30000.
89' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
87' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bayer Leverkusen, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
84' Substitution. Lennard Maloney makes way for Luca Kerber (Heidenheim).
82' 5 - 2 Goal - 5:2! Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) tries his luck from the edge of the box and scores with an accurate shot inside the left post. Nathan Tella provided an assist for the goal.

80' Bayer Leverkusen slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
77' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Florian Wirtz.
77' Here comes a substitution. Exequiel Palacios is given a rest as he is replaced by Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen).
76' There's an opportunity for Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
76' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Now Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
75' Bayer Leverkusen are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
71' 4 - 2 Goal! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) makes the score 4:2 after burying a close-range header in the left side of the goal after a good run and cross by Arthur.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) will replace Aleix Garcia.
69' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
68' Bayer Leverkusen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

67' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
65' Corner kicks – 4:0.
63' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
62' Here comes a substitution. Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Mathias Honsak.
62' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Adrian Beck and he is replaced by Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim).
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) comes onto the pitch so that Niklas Dorsch can be given a rest.
61' Bayer Leverkusen are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
58' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a rough challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for an infringement.
57' Wonderful movement by Bayer Leverkusen. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
55' What an excellent shot, but not the luckiest one. Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) fires the ball from inside the penalty box but it only hits the left post!
54' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

52' 3 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Florian Wirtz, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen), who beats Kevin Muller with a brilliant shot into the top of the net. 3:2.
51' The current number of shots on goal is 6:3.
49' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

47' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bayer Leverkusen are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' The linesman makes the right call and Bayer Leverkusen will have a corner.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.

45+6' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
45+3' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is substituted due to injury. Xabi Alonso gives a chance to Nathan Tella.
45+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bayer Leverkusen, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
44' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
43' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) plays a one-two with Patrik Schick, but the move breaks down.
41' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayer Leverkusen comes to nothing.

40' Kevin Muller was forced into action to thwart Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot to the left post but couldn't beat the keeper. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. They send men into the box.
38' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) has a sight of goal and shoots from distance, but Kevin Muller is equal to it.
37' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Bastian Dankert who sees an offensive foul.
35' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
32' 2 - 2 GOAL! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Kevin Muller, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 2:2.
30' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Granit Xhaka laid the ball off to Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen), who shot from close range into the right side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
28' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is out of play. Heidenheim will take a throw-in.
28' Frank Schmidt is forced to make a change. Marvin Pieringer is unable to continue due to injury, Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) comes on.
27' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the left post!
25' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.

24' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Kevin Muller.

21' 0 - 2 Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Lukas Hradecky is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 0:2.
19' The ball is cleared after Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
17' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
15' Bayer Leverkusen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

15' Bayer Leverkusen are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The referee blows his whistle, Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.

13' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.

12' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Kevin Muller scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
10' 0 - 1 Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the left side of the goal.
10' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Heidenheim, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
9' Poor challenge! Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) is penalised for tripping and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle.
7' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
6' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

6' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
4' A long-range effort by Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) after he received a good pass was well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
